source_cause.transaction_reference: transaction_result%temporal_indicator is overwritten on each solver-successful attempt
source_cause.canonical_interval_runtime: kernel diagnostics max_temporal_indicator takes max only across transaction_result%temporal_indicator values, not across retry attempts
source_cause.effect: for a retry-exhausted single transaction followed by solver failures, the field named max_temporal_indicator contains the last solver-successful temporal indicator

interpretation: The RM19 accept/reject result is valid: each of the first three solver-successful attempts individually exceeds the threshold 1.
The reported diagnostic underestimates the actual maximum by a factor of about 3.905.
The full-window temporal indicator is the true maximum over the frozen successful retry attempts.
The diagnostic aggregation should be repaired independently from any temporal policy discussion.
nonclaims: RM21 does not alter the temporal budget.
RM21 does not admit a shorter timestep.
RM21 does not alter any transaction acceptance decision.
RM21 does not resolve the scientific applicability of HEAD_BUDGET=1e-5 cm.
next_required_boundary: Repair max_temporal_indicator aggregation to include every solver-successful retry attempt and replay existing transaction behavior unchanged. Separately establish the provenance/applicability of the active-irrigation temporal budget.
